old_age_pension.name: IGNOAPS Old Age Pension
old_age_pension.eligibility: Citizen above 60 years with low income.
steps: Visit the official portal or your local CSC
Fill out the online application form
Upload your Age and Income proofs
Submit and wait for verification
old_age_pension.apply: Visit nearest Panchayat office or State Social Welfare portal.

ayushman_bharat.name: Ayushman Bharat Health Card
ayushman_bharat.eligibility: Low income family under SECC database.
steps: Go to your nearest Common Service Center (CSC) or empaneled hospital
Verify your name in the SECC 2011 database
Complete KYC using Aadhar
Print your Ayushman Card

ration_card.name: Ration Card (NFS)
steps: Visit your State Food Supply Office portal
Submit head of household application
Attach Address and Income Proofs
Complete verification by local authority
ration_card.apply: Apply through State Food Supply Office.

kerala_old_age_pension.name: Kerala Old Age Pension
kerala_old_age_pension.eligibility: 60 years or above, permanent resident of Kerala, family income below Rs. 100000.
steps: Visit the Sevana Pension portal or your Grama Panchayat
Fill the application form for Old Age Pension
Submit Income Certificate and Age Proof
Wait for local entity verification process
kerala_old_age_pension.apply: Apply through Sevana Pension portal or Grama Panchayat.

kerala_widow_pension.name: Kerala Widow Pension
kerala_widow_pension.eligibility: Widows or destitute women, resident of Kerala, family income below Rs. 100000.
steps: Visit your local body office or Sevana portal
Provide Husband's Death Certificate
Submit Income Proof
Complete local village officer verification
kerala_widow_pension.apply: Apply through Sevana Pension portal or localized local body.

kerala_agriculture_pension.name: Kerala Agricultural Labour Pension
kerala_agriculture_pension.eligibility: Agricultural labourers over 60 years of age, resident of Kerala, family income below Rs. 100000.
steps: Get Labour Certificate from agricultural officer
Visit Sevana Pension portal
Upload Labour and Income proof
Complete submission process
kerala_agriculture_pension.apply: Apply through Sevana Pension portal or Grama Panchayat.

kerala_disability_pension.name: Kerala Disability Pension
kerala_disability_pension.eligibility: Persons with more than 40% disability, resident of Kerala, family income below Rs. 100000.
steps: Obtain formal Disability Certificate (40%+)
Go to Sevana portal or Grama Panchayat
Submit application along with medical proofs
Wait for local committee clearance
kerala_disability_pension.apply: Apply through Sevana Pension portal or Grama Panchayat.
